description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Relentless Dead, adding {B}.
Relentless Dead's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve Relentless Dead's first ability, causing you to pay {B} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Relentless Dead's second abilitiy, choosing not to pay.
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {0}.
Repeat.
